name: Lucas Leto
bio: Lucas Leto (Salvador, January 13, 1999) is a Brazilian actor.

credits.title: Where the River Takes You
credits.overview: During a farewell carnival, a young artist falls for a stranger who hides a supernatural secret.

credits.title: Todo o Sentimento
credits.overview: Todo o Sentimento follows Henrique, a filmmaker marked by past traumas. In Recôncavo Baiano, his path crosses with Gustavo's, a young man who brings renewal and lightness into his life. This unexpected encounter transforms pain into affection, exploring emotional healing through black and peripheral relationships.

credits.title: God's Lawyer
credits.overview: Daniel is a newly graduated lawyer who faces family conflicts due to disagreements with his father's business dealings; his father is a federal congressman. Alongside a friend, the young man becomes involved in a case that dates back to past lives, discovering he is connected to a complex spiritual web.

credits.title: Heart Tray
credits.overview: João, in the presence of a compelling waiter, re-signifies a problematic love from the past.

credits.title: 1798 - Revolta dos Búzios
credits.overview: One of the most important events in Brazilian history, the Búzios Revolt of 1798 was led by dozens of black men who rose up to overthrow the colonial government, proclaim independence and establish a democratic Republic, free from slavery. credits.title: An Unforgettable Year - Autumn
credits.overview: An ambitious law student who hates music needs to make a perfect plan to get hired at the office she interns at – until she meets a charming singer who shakes her life. While she's living her first love, she needs to face her own past and decide what's more important: do what she loves or learn to love what she does.

credits.title: Fenced In
credits.overview: After a nervous breakdown, Walter trades the city for the countryside. But his hopes for a calm life are shattered once he meets his loud new neighbors.
